The '''Gemon-4 ion engine''' was a capital-scale [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] manufactured by [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]]. Four Gemon-4 ion engines were used for emergency or supplementary sublight drives on [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] and three [[Destroyer-I ion engine/Legends|Destroyer-I ion engines]] served as main engine units.<ref name="EGVV" />
